Their voices. Their stories. Kept forever.

EverKeep is a private family archive where the stories, voice recordings, letters and photographs of the people you love are preserved with care — so grandchildren not yet born can hear a great-grandmother laugh, in her own words, in her own voice.

Everything a shoebox can't hold onto

Photographs fade. Letters are lost in a move. A voice, once gone, can't be called back. EverKeep gathers all of it into one lasting archive, organised by the people at the heart of it.

Photographs & albums

Gather scattered prints, albums and snapshots into one place, each one labelled with the names, places and occasions that give it meaning — before the last person who remembers them is gone.

Build a page for each family member, from the oldest portrait to the newest grandchild.

Voice recordings

Record a parent telling how they met, a grandfather's war story, a recipe explained the way only your mother explains it. EverKeep keeps the recording alongside the story it belongs to, ready to be heard generations from now.

Stories & letters

Write down the stories while they're still told at the table, and keep the letters, cards and documents that carry your family's handwriting. Dates, milestones and memories come together on one timeline per person.
